name: Grand Prismatic Overlook and Fairy Falls
why: Up a short trail to look down on Grand Prismatic Spring's rings of blue, green and orange, then on through young lodgepoles to a 60 m waterfall.
book: No permit. Park entrance fee. Fairy Falls trailhead parking is small: arrive early.
water: None on the trail: carry 1-2 litres.
dangers: Stay on the trail: the ground around hot springs is thin and the water scalding.
Bison and grizzly bears: keep 25 m from bison and 90 m from bears.

points.name: Fairy Falls trailhead
points.note: A bridge over the Firehole River south of Midway Geyser Basin.

points.name: Grand Prismatic Spring Overlook
points.note: A platform on the hill above the largest hot spring in the United States.

points.name: Fairy Falls
points.note: A thin fall of 60 m over a cliff in the forest.
